page_review.title: Low-Poly PSX Style Essential Doors Pack
page_review.author: Icevanilla
page_review.description: A pack of 6 low-poly PSX-style interior doors including closet, bathroom, standard wooden, worn wooden and one front door.
page_review.download_modal_terms: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
page_review.visible_geometry: Six standing door/frame assemblies in one row. The leftmost closet has two leaves and is excluded; the other five are candidate single leaves with visibly different panels/hardware.

selected_source.operation: Keep the named single-leaf door and its matching modeled frame; omit four other single-leaf displays and the double-leaf closet display. Preserve the original USDZ and the selected meshes, UVs and shared CC BY texture. Rebase its package-relative texture path to the copied local map.

license_dependency_review: One 4096 x 1024 texture is packaged in the CC BY USDZ. Original stage metadata matches author, CC-BY-4.0 and page URL; no separate terms were found. Selection retains the corresponding model/frame and locally rebases the packaged map reference.
local_geometry_review: Inspect 000003: 400 triangles, 4 connected parts; component 0 is the modeled U-frame, leaf is 3, other components are door hardware. Inspected leaf 0.7558 x 1.8060 x 0.0857 m; frame inner-right overhang versus leaf is 1.32 mm, left gap 3.04 mm, top gap -0.50 mm.
